title: Lower ME: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Goblet Squat w/ Heartbeat × 8 · Inchworm Push-Up × 6 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side
jumps: Back Squat 3 · 5-sec lower @ RPE 7.5 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Eccentric wk 2: heavier, 5 sec down · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent
Quick off the floor, stiff ankles
strength: Slow, hold a rack or wall
note: Eccentric wk 2: more weight on the bar, 5-second lowering. Write down your heavy-step weight.
